# Operator reference

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by backend/scripts/gen_docs.py — do not edit by hand. -->

QuantLab's alpha DSL provides **82 operators**. They compose freely with data fields and arithmetic (`+ - * /`, unary `-`). `x` is a `(dates × tickers)` matrix; `d` is an integer lookback in trading days.

## Time series

| Operator | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ts_mean` | `(x, d)` | Rolling mean of x over d periods |
| `ts_std` | `(x, d)` | Rolling stdev of x over d periods |
| `ts_min` | `(x, d)` | Rolling min over d periods |
| `ts_max` | `(x, d)` | Rolling max over d periods |
| `ts_sum` | `(x, d)` | Rolling sum over d periods |
| `ts_rank` | `(x, d)` | Rolling percentile rank in [0,1] over d periods |
| `ts_median` | `(x, d)` | Rolling median |
| `ts_skewness` | `(x, d)` | Rolling skewness |
| `ts_kurtosis` | `(x, d)` | Rolling excess kurtosis |
| `ts_zscore` | `(x, d)` | (x - rolling_mean) / rolling_std |
| `ts_quantile` | `(x, d, q=0.5)` | Rolling q-th quantile |
| `ts_arg_max` | `(x, d)` | Days-ago index of rolling max (0 = today) |
| `ts_arg_min` | `(x, d)` | Days-ago index of rolling min (0 = today) |
| `ts_product` | `(x, d)` | Rolling product over d periods |
| `ts_returns` | `(x, d)` | Multi-period simple return: x / x.shift(d) - 1 |
| `ts_decay_exp` | `(x, d, factor=0.5)` | Exponentially-weighted MA over d periods |
| `ts_partial_corr` | `(x, y, z, d)` | Rolling partial correlation of x,y controlling for z |
| `ts_regression` | `(y, x, d)` | Rolling OLS slope: cov(x,y) / var(x) |
| `ts_min_max_diff` | `(x, d)` | Rolling (max - min); volatility proxy |
| `delta` | `(x, d)` | x - x.shift(d) |
| `delay` | `(x, d)` | x.shift(d) |
| `decay_linear` | `(x, d)` | Linearly weighted MA over d periods |
| `ts_corr` | `(x, y, d)` | Rolling Pearson correlation over d periods |
| `ts_cov` | `(x, y, d)` | Rolling covariance over d periods |
| `days_from_last_change` | `(x)` | Days since the value last changed (per ticker) |
| `hump` | `(x, threshold=0.01)` | Smoothing: only update when \|x - prev\| > threshold |

## Cross sectional

| Operator | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rank` | `(x)` | Cross-sectional percentile rank in [0,1] per date |
| `zscore` | `(x)` | Cross-sectional z-score per date |
| `demean` | `(x)` | Subtract cross-sectional mean per date |
| `scale` | `(x)` | Scale so \|sum\|=1 per date |
| `normalize` | `(x)` | Demean then scale to unit \|sum\| |
| `winsorize` | `(x, std=4)` | Clip each row at ±std·sigma around the row mean |
| `quantile` | `(x, q=0.5)` | Per-row q-th quantile broadcast across columns |
| `vector_neut` | `(x, y)` | Project x orthogonal to y (per row) |
| `regression_neut` | `(x, y)` | Cross-sectional OLS residual of x on y |
| `correlation` | `(x, y)` | Per-day cross-sectional Pearson correlation between x and y, broadcast across columns (distinct from ts_corr which rolls over time) |
| `cap_weight` | `(x)` | Market-cap-weighted variant of x; multiplies by market_cap then re-ranks cross-sectionally so the result is bounded [0,1] per day |
| `adv` | `(d)` | Average dollar volume over the trailing d days — equivalent to ts_mean(dollar_volume, d); accepts any d, not just 20 |
| `bucket` | `(x, n=5)` | Discretize each row into n equal-frequency buckets [0..n-1] |
| `tail` | `(x, lower, upper, replace)` | Replace cells outside [lower, upper] with `replace` |
| `kth_element` | `(x, k)` | Per-row k-th smallest (k=-1 for max) |
| `harmonic_mean` | `(x)` | Per-row harmonic mean broadcast across columns |
| `geometric_mean` | `(x)` | Per-row geometric mean broadcast across columns |
| `step` | `(x)` | Per-row linear ramp from -1 to +1 by rank |

## Group

| Operator | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group_rank` | `(x, group)` | Per row, percentile-rank x within each group |
| `group_zscore` | `(x, group)` | Per row, z-score within each group |
| `group_neutralize` | `(x, group)` | Subtract the group mean from each member |
| `neutralize` | `(x, group)` | Alias for group_neutralize — matches the Brain Fast-Expression spec |
| `group_mean` | `(x, group)` | Broadcast group mean to each member |
| `group_sum` | `(x, group)` | Broadcast group sum to each member |
| `group_count` | `(x, group)` | Broadcast group count to each member |
| `group_max` | `(x, group)` | Broadcast group max to each member |
| `group_min` | `(x, group)` | Broadcast group min to each member |
| `group_normalize` | `(x, group)` | Demean within group, scale to \|sum\|=1 per group |
| `group_scale` | `(x, group)` | Scale so \|sum\|=1 within each group |

## Arithmetic

| Operator | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `abs` | `(x)` | Element-wise absolute value |
| `log` | `(x)` | Element-wise natural log (NaN for x<=0) |
| `exp` | `(x)` | Element-wise e^x |
| `sqrt` | `(x)` | Element-wise sqrt (NaN for x<0) |
| `mod` | `(x, y)` | x mod y element-wise (NaN for y=0) |
| `sign` | `(x)` | Element-wise sign (-1, 0, +1) |
| `power` | `(x, n)` | x ** n element-wise |
| `signed_power` | `(x, n)` | sign(x) * \|x\|^n; preserves sign |
| `sigmoid` | `(x)` | Logistic sigmoid 1/(1+e^-x) |
| `clip` | `(x, lo, hi)` | Clamp each cell to [lo, hi] |
| `max` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise max |
| `min` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise min |
| `replace` | `(x, old, new)` | Replace cells equal to `old` with `new` |
| `isnan` | `(x)` | 1.0 where cell is NaN, else 0.0 |
| `equal` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise equality indicator (0/1) |
| `less` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise x < y; returns 1.0 / 0.0 |
| `greater` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise x > y; returns 1.0 / 0.0 |
| `less_eq` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise x <= y; returns 1.0 / 0.0 |
| `greater_eq` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise x >= y; returns 1.0 / 0.0 |
| `not_equal` | `(x, y)` | Element-wise x != y; returns 1.0 / 0.0 |

## Conditional

| Operator | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `if_else` | `(cond, x, y)` | Element-wise conditional |
| `where` | `(cond, x, y)` | Alias for if_else with truthy cond |
| `when` | `(cond, x)` | x where cond is True, else NaN (no carry) |
| `mask` | `(x, cond)` | Drop cells to NaN where cond is True (inverse of when) |
| `trade_when` | `(cond, x, exit_cond=None)` | Take x when cond, carry forward; reset on exit_cond |
| `keep` | `(x, n)` | Per row, keep top-n entries by \|x\|; zero rest |
| `pasteurize` | `(x)` | Replace ±inf and NaN with 0 |
